title: Vampires: The datapack
description: An Among Us Style Minigame to play with your server mates.
body:
# Vampires: The Datapack

A halloween themed, Among Us like, minigame to add to your server. Contains unique abilities, custom models, and loot bags!

Add a competitive, but fun, minigame that can be customized to your servers likings for timings. Add some spooky to your days!

## The goal

### The Players

Each player will be given an item to place a 'Core' in their base. This is the lifeblood of your characters while the game is active. Defend it, hide it, do what you need to stop the vampires from finding your base.

### The Vampires
![Vampire Ability Icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99f90347304452662fb5eb73021cd3bac7a37449.png)

Using their abilities, the vampires must seek and convert each player to be one of their own kind. At the same time, they must find the players bases as this keep them strong.

### Rewards
![An image of a loot bundle and the tooltip which reads "A bundle full of legendary loot!"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8z0f5vGX/images/b8c9da170c434c5bce6720b9869595b7bf15c775.png)

When the vampires convert a player or find all the bases they are rewarded with a goodie bag to help them further. 

When players surive the night, they are rewarded for if they don't get infected, or if their base remains to be found.

Goodie bags will contain useful items, tools/weapons, and much more.

## How to setup
Setup is simple, install and enable the datapack, and every player will be given their base creation item and joined into the game on their first log in to the server. While not technically required, the [resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vampires-resourcepack) should be used for best usecase as custom items will be missing their textures, and abilities will be viewable by non-vampires.

Once your players are ready, an admin can run one of the following commands to begin the game:

```
/function vampires:start
```
or

```
/function vampires:start_custom {delay:X}
```

Where X is the amount of seconds you wish a round to begin, by default this is set to 24000 seconds (just around 6.5 hours).

## Removal/Uninstall

```
/function vampires:utility/cleanup
```
This should remove most things added via the datapack and cleanup any bases in the world. Somethings may be left behind is some players are offline.
